format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards |>
  filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55, long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_point(aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55))
```
